title: Fine reach-kinematics decoding from calcium

titles: Mouse M1/S1 reaching and grasping calcium, 3D kinematics and M1 inactivation

scientific_question: How accurately can session-local M1 or S1 calcium-derived activity predict measured joint angles or velocities on complete held-out lift-conditioned reach windows beyond phase and reach-target references?
primary_outputs: The 24 ordered measured jointAngles trajectories in degrees OR the 24 jointVelocities trajectories in degrees/second, scored in separate requests; they are not a single 48-channel endpoint.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.
data_manifest.subject_count_evidence: Author archive description and pinned docs/SUMMARY.md. Optogenetic recordings use two additional named mouse files; not pooled with the imaging cohort.

recording_contract.neural: Trial R structs contain events and hasNeuralData; eventLockData returns time × ROI data. Raw/denoised calcium and RADICaL-derived variants are distinct allowed-input choices, not interchangeable raw spikes.
recording_contract.labels: R/M sources yield 3D marker positions and 24 joint angles/velocities, LR reach target and event intervals. Optogenetic trial labels are available for a separate behavioral intervention task.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Pinned eventLockData subtracts syncTime from event timestamps, aligns frameTimes using cycleDurMs and corrects ROILags. tPts and cycleDurMs use milliseconds; resampling to 10 ms does not create 100 Hz independent observations.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Imaging mice cfa17,cfa19,cfa20,cfa22,cfa24; two dated sessions per mouse, M1 and S1 per docs. R(1).animalID and timestamped filenames provide grouping. Separate optogenetic files cfaVG1/cfaVG4.
recording_contract.evidence: Published 13-file inventory; pinned loadData, eventLockData, loadLock4Decode, decode and SUMMARY inspected. Data schema comes from author source, not loaded MAT structures.

missing_or_unverified: This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Primary delivered recipe: 100 training-variance-selected session-local ROI features from smoothed deconvolved events (source neurons.data, 35 ms smoothing SD), 51 samples at 10 ms spacing, no added predictor lags.
Public lift-time grid and left/right reach target are shared with comparators; all fits, cell ranking, centering and 90-component PCA use declared training trials only.
RADICaL is a separately declared feature track with upstream temporal support at least [-200,+900] ms; it is not silently exchanged with primary features.
forbidden_inputs: Held-out kinematic trajectories, evaluation-derived cell selection/PCA/normalization, full-session ZETA selection, answer-bearing filenames and private scorer compound request.
Any undeclared extra upstream observation window or cross-session ROI correspondence.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Exact normalized session IDs are the ten identities enumerated in SCHEMA.md; original trial IDs must match neural_trial_id and target_trial_id. Native admitted trial census is not yet available.
allowed_inputs.split: Implemented prospective within-session split is whole-trial target-stratified SHA256 ranking with seed 240926, 90/10 train/evaluation and upward-rounded evaluation counts; no timepoint split. Five separately declared local-calibration outer cases are optional and are not parameter transfer.
allowed_inputs.coverage: All five mice, both named areas/sessions, every selected trial, all 51 time points and all 24 joints required. Exact native eligibility/exclusion counts remain unverified; selected windows do not imply complete reaching behavior ends by +400 ms.

biological_unit: Five mice cfa17,cfa19,cfa20,cfa22,cfa24; two M1/S1 sessions each are dependent observations.
case_definition: One original reach trial with all 51 samples from -100 to +400 ms relative to liftTimeDLC, nested within a named imaging session.

split.policy: Implemented prospective within-session split is whole-trial target-stratified SHA256 ranking with seed 240926, 90/10 train/evaluation and upward-rounded evaluation counts; no timepoint split. Five separately declared local-calibration outer cases are optional and are not parameter transfer.
split.coverage: All five mice, both named areas/sessions, every selected trial, all 51 time points and all 24 joints required. Exact native eligibility/exclusion counts remain unverified; selected windows do not imply complete reaching behavior ends by +400 ms.

reference.role: Reference-analysis-only: decode.m performs PCA before cvRegress. A benchmark baseline must fit PCA and selection inside training folds; author result reproduction and leakage-safe prediction are different contracts.

controls: Train-only cell selection/PCA; original trial-identity equality instead of positional neural/kinematic pairing.
Fixed same cell and window budgets in M1/S1; source eligibility and upstream exposure must be frozen and disclosed.
Session-local feature spaces; never infer matched neurons or cross-animal transfer from equal array widths.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed numeric calcium matrices and fixed lift grid could support direct complete-trajectory answers; no no-tools context/collector is supplied.
direct_observation.boundary: Only public calibration labels and query neural/context values; hold all evaluation kinematics private.
missing: Complete no-tools observation and response protocol.

typed_viewer.representation: A source-faithful trace/raster viewer could expose 100-ROI calcium windows; none is supplied.
typed_viewer.boundary: Typed trace selection/rendering must preserve fixed observations without returning target trajectories.
missing: Renderer, restricted action schema and matched numerical observation budget.

tool_assisted.representation: Numerical fit/score functions are operator APIs; a case-adaptive investigator transport is not supplied.
tool_assisted.boundary: Proposed equal data, tool/checkpoint and compute access with no private compound scoring request.
missing: Per-case tool transport and independently protected scorer.

frozen_program.representation: Operator-only numerical source is present: Training-only numerical decoder and complete external-prediction scoring API. This does not deliver a participant-facing frozen program mode.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze recipe, eligibility and observation support before evaluation; candidate receives training labels and query neural values only.

primary.name: Mouse-macro training-SD-normalized RMSE
primary.aggregation: RMSE per session/joint over equally weighted complete trials/time points divided by that joint training population SD; equal 24 joints, equal two sessions within mouse, equal five mice.
primary.rationale: Scores measured kinematics directly while retaining biological weighting and training-only normalization; fixed-source prediction agreement is not the target.

secondary: Within-session/joint SSE/SST R² then equal sessions/mice; constant target variance remains undefined.
Per-area and per-joint errors, phase/target comparator differences and trial-shift diagnostic; angles and velocities remain separate.

comparators.name: Frozen session-local neural ridge
comparators.inputs: Identical training calcium and kinematics; query neural features only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented training variance ranking, 100 ROIs, 90 PCA components, unpenalized target mean and ridge alpha 1 in sum-SSE units.

comparators.name: Phase-by-direction mean
comparators.inputs: Training kinematics plus public lift grid and reach target.
comparators.procedure: Implemented training-only average trajectory for each reach direction; separate phase-only and direction-only means retained.

comparators.name: Whole-training-trial neural rotation
comparators.inputs: Same complete training neural trajectories within each direction.
comparators.procedure: Implemented cyclic rotation by original trial order followed by identical fit; diagnostic, not a permutation significance test.

nuisance_controls: Train-only cell selection/PCA; original trial-identity equality instead of positional neural/kinematic pairing.
Fixed same cell and window budgets in M1/S1; source eligibility and upstream exposure must be frozen and disclosed.
Session-local feature spaces; never infer matched neurons or cross-animal transfer from equal array widths.
evaluation.uncertainty: Retain five mouse differences and descriptive paired enumeration of all 5^5 ordered mouse bootstrap resamples; five animals do not establish population coverage or a significance threshold.
evaluation.failure_policy: Missing/extra trials, sessions, ROI identities, time points or joints and nonfinite values reject. Zero training SD or evaluation variance propagates undefined scores without dropping affected joints/mice.
